title: Travel Agent — An Escape Brochure
audio_processing: Original recording, no speed changes; 60 ms opening fade and 350 ms ending fade for excerpt playback.
technique: Original deterministic Canvas2D drawings; layered paper, ink, articulated character animation and camera transforms. No paid generation.

shots.description: A traveler asks for a ticket. The agency's sea poster begins to escape its frame.
The counter becomes a pier. The traveler drifts away in a folded ticket.
A route lifts from a folded map and becomes a red bird.
The bird leads the boat into paper mountains and an ocean, toward another tiny travel agency.
